title: Wonder and Method — Clear Value, Distinct Choices
positioning: Midrange and higher-end websites, local search and practical digital work, delivered with an AI-assisted workflow.
status: Proposed V3 operating design. Independent review applies to a controlled pilot; no live offer or existing commitment changes.

inputs.preferred_positioning: Midrange and higher-end; latest user choice supersedes V1 preference for only fewer premium clients
excluded_now: Social media services, including templates and posting
Advertising setup, creative and campaign management
Ongoing email campaign management while marked learning
unconfirmed: New customer interviews for case-study production
inputs.v3_decisions: User chose 8 / 10 / 15 / 20 pages at unchanged fees after reviewing the closest published comparisons. This supersedes the earlier 7 / 9 / 12 / 20 draft and explicit Business 12 request. Storefront information pages rise 5→6; products, audit samples, maintained-site limits, collection entries and module quantities remain separate units.

economics.meaning: Fee less modeled direct costs divided by complete reserved owner hours. Focused reserves 100% above its seven-hour base; other scopes reserve 25%. These scenario ratios are not profit, wages, demand forecasts or measured delivery rates.
economics.assumptions: The larger V3 scope reserves 14 / 17.5 / 32.5 / 51.25 complete owner hours for Focused / Custom / Business / Signature. These are unmeasured planning judgments, including communication, research, revisions, QA and support. Track actual AI/Semrush/tool costs, payment fees, overhead and tax separately. Client-paid hosting and subscriptions are separate. No word-count efficiency is assumed to justify cutting the accepted deliverable.
economics.pilot_gate: Log at least three complete projects/cycles per offer before reducing reserves or describing a repeatable turnaround. Include intake, manual factual/design review, AI supervision, calls, revisions, QA, launch, post-launch checks and defect work. Track AI waiting and client waiting separately. Underestimation does not reduce the accepted deliverable; adjust future scope, fees, dates or booking limits when observed work requires it.

plans.name: Website Roadmap
plans.fit: An owner with an existing website who needs an independent diagnosis and a practical decision about fixes, a rebuild or ongoing work.
plans.result: An evidence-backed action plan that another competent provider could also implement.
includes: One structured written owner intake; one website/domain; up to 10 agreed public pages and one primary inquiry journey. Optional 60-minute discovery appointment.

Review message clarity, navigation, mobile usability, basic accessibility, performance, search visibility foundations and the contact journey. Use read-only analytics/Search Console access where available; record missing data.
Inspect up to three relevant competitor websites for useful differences. This is a bounded comparison, not a market-size study.
Deliver a concise findings report with screenshots, affected URLs, severity, why each finding matters, and the next action. Prioritize up to 10 findings into now / next / later.
Provide a proposed 90-day sequence, an outline of the recommended scope, and an estimate for W&M implementation if requested.
Written findings explanation plus a recorded walkthrough and one consolidated factual-correction round; optional 30-minute findings appointment.
excludes: Repairs or new page production
Penetration testing, legal accessibility certification, exhaustive SEO crawling, or revenue attribution
Private application screens, stores with complex checkout, or several websites
stages: Written intake, access check and confirmed page/journey sample.
Tool-assisted inspection, manual verification and competitor context.
Findings walkthrough and consolidated factual corrections.
Verify corrections and deliver the final report and next steps.
inputs: Website URL; main business goal and known problems
Read-only analytics access if available; permission and a safe method to test the form
One decision maker and accurate business/service information
acceptance: Every priority links to evidence and an affected page or journey.
Recommendations distinguish a confirmed fault from a hypothesis.
The owner can identify the first three actions, their dependencies and who should do them.
plans.note: A Roadmap is optional. Do not require it when an owner can proceed directly to a clearly scoped build. If its paid work is reused in a later engagement, remove the overlapping work and show the resulting credit in that proposal; do not bill for the same discovery twice.
plans.example: A service company receives a documented decision to repair its inquiry form and rewrite two pages before considering a full rebuild.
plans.support: For 14 calendar days after delivery, answer clarification questions about the report and correct factual errors. Implementation is a new scope.
plans.estimate_basis: Four owner hours is a proposed assisted-review estimate. The agreed call lengths, manual validation and factual-correction round remain included.

plans.name: Brand & Message Sprint
plans.fit: An established business whose audience, offer or message is unclear enough to hold back a website project.
plans.result: A usable message and visual-direction brief for the business and its next website.
includes: Written positioning workbook and decision exchange; one business and one primary market. Optional 90-minute workshop and 45-minute decision appointment.
Review supplied business/customer evidence and up to three competitors. Develop up to two primary customer profiles from that evidence, marking assumptions.
One positioning statement, one main value proposition, a message hierarchy, up to three service/offer descriptions, and five headline options with a selected recommendation.
A voice guide with three short before/after writing examples; a homepage content outline rather than a completed website.
One visual direction using the existing identity: color palette, type pairing, image direction and a compact usage guide.
Two consolidated review rounds: message decisions, then selected-direction refinement. Editable documents and recorded/written handoff; optional 45-minute appointment.
excludes: New original logo or business naming
Customer interviews, surveys, trademark research, photography or a full brand campaign
Full website copy or implementation; social media and advertising services
stages: Written discovery, supplied-evidence review and competitor comparison.
Positioning, messages and visual-direction presentation; first feedback round.
Selected-direction refinements, second round and handoff.
inputs: Owner participation; current offers, prices and real customer evidence
Existing logo/files and permissioned examples
One approver willing to choose a direction
acceptance: Approved audience and positioning decisions are explicit.
Claims trace to supplied facts; unverified claims are removed or marked.
The brief contains copy examples, color/type specifications and usable source documents.
plans.note: Website plans already include the discovery needed for their agreed scope. Sell this sprint only when a separate positioning decision is genuinely needed. Reused work reduces the subsequent website scope and fee.
plans.example: A company offering unrelated services chooses a primary audience, organizes three offers, and gains a clear brief before commissioning its website.
plans.support: 30 calendar days to report defects against the accepted scope. New requests, third-party changes and ongoing maintenance are separately scoped.
plans.estimate_basis: Retained scope-specific V1 planning estimate; no measured delivery history supplied. AI assistance is available but no blanket percentage time saving is assumed.

plans.name: Website Repair Sprint
plans.fit: An owner with a functioning, accessible website and a small number of specific problems worth fixing without a rebuild.
plans.result: A finite set of agreed improvements, implemented and retested with before/after evidence.
includes: A short access/platform check, written scope confirmation and reproduction of the reported problems; optional 45-minute scope appointment.
Agree up to three bounded fixes before booking. The total implementation work must fit six planned production hours; preparation, testing, communication and contingency are budgeted separately.

Typical eligible fixes: correct a form delivery/confirmation path; fix a mobile layout issue in one shared component; optimize specified first-party images/fonts; repair agreed metadata/indexability settings; or rewrite and implement one existing page for its agreed purpose.
Create a backup or rollback path before changes. Use a preview/staging environment when the platform supports it.
Implement the exact accepted fix list, run the defined checks, and provide a change log and before/after evidence.
One consolidated preview-feedback round and written/recorded handoff; optional 30-minute appointment. W&M-caused defects are corrected without consuming a paid addition.
excludes: A whole-site redesign, unbounded speed cleanup or guaranteed Lighthouse score
Malware recovery, unsupported legacy plugins, major migrations or custom application repair
New checkout, complex integrations, third-party outages or recovery of inaccessible accounts
stages: Confirm access, reproduce each problem, record rollback and agree the up-to-three-fix scope.
Implement the agreed fixes and perform initial regression checks.
One consolidated review, corrections and retesting; a five-day completion requires feedback by day 4.
Explicit acceptance, approved release, before/after evidence and handoff. Larger faults remain a separately quoted scope.
inputs: Working administrator access and an authorized owner
A clear problem list and permission for test submissions
A recoverable environment or separately approved recovery setup
acceptance: Each agreed fix passes its written before/after check.
Changed forms are tested through receipt and confirmation, not just the submit button.
No identified material regression in the touched pages or shared components.
plans.note: The six-hour production allowance is a pre-sale scoping tool, not permission to stop halfway through an accepted fixed-fee deliverable. If work cannot be bounded, recommend Roadmap or a separate estimate before taking the project. Choose the coordinated sprint when shared components, investigation or regression work require one combined scope. If requests are genuinely independent known faults that fit Single Website Fix, quote those modules where appropriate; three requests do not automatically require the higher sprint fee.
plans.example: Repair one failed inquiry notification, improve its confirmation message, and correct one mobile navigation issue.
plans.support: 30 calendar days to report defects against the accepted scope. New requests, third-party changes and ongoing maintenance are separately scoped.
plans.estimate_basis: Retained scope-specific V1 planning estimate; no measured delivery history supplied. AI assistance is available but no blanket percentage time saving is assumed.

plans.name: Focused Website
plans.fit: A new or established service business with one clear offer, one decision maker and ready business facts, needing a complete professional presence.
plans.result: A complete eight-page website with original writing, an established design direction adapted to your business, and a tested inquiry path.
includes: Structured written intake, one audience, one primary inquiry journey and an eight-page plan. Review up to two relevant competitors. An optional 30-minute kickoff can replace the written kickoff.

Up to eight marketing pages with original AI-assisted writing, edited and checked against approved business facts. Content is as concise or detailed as the topic, reader and search intent require; there is no word quota or word-count surcharge for the agreed page purpose.

Select and adapt one established W&M layout direction. Apply the client’s logo, colors, typography, spacing and imagery consistently. The client sees the design approach before booking; a newly art-directed visual system is a Custom Website scope.
Prepare up to eight supplied/licensed photographs and one simple original website graphic. No original logo, commissioned photography or motion production.

One contact form with up to eight fields, one notification destination, spam controls and confirmation; one existing booking/payment tool link or embed. New provider configuration and automations are separate.

One agreed supported platform. If needed, one standard content collection with up to six supplied entries using the established component set. Up to three client-supplied policy pages are formatted outside the eight marketing-page count.

Two consolidated review rounds: copy/design direction, then complete preview. Shared launch checks, audit/check record and explicit launch approval. Written editing guide and recorded demonstration; optional 20-minute handoff appointment.
Client-controlled domain and service accounts, an ownership/license inventory, checks within two business days and around day 14 after launch, and 30-day defect support. Optional Care is separate.

Search-ready page planning: map each agreed service or buyer question to its page; review search intent and relevant query themes, write unique titles/descriptions, connect related pages with internal links, and apply the shared technical search checks. Search demand informs useful content; rankings are not guaranteed.

Written communication by default: email or the agreed text channel anytime, with acknowledgement within one business day during active delivery/support. Weekly project updates; optional calls by appointment. No call is required to buy, give feedback or receive the handoff.

Launch handover pack: page and account inventory, test/check record, editing guide with recorded demonstration, support dates, and a prioritized next-90-days recommendation sheet. This is a handoff recommendation, not ongoing SEO delivery or a new full audit.
excludes: A new visual identity, original art direction or multiple homepage concepts
Store, portal, custom calculator, conditional form, migration or custom application
New tool-account setup, original field research, ongoing SEO, social media and advertising
stages: Confirm facts, photographs, logo, access, page inventory, selected established design direction, approver and booked start.
Kickoff, page plan, edited copy and direction preview; first review. A five-day completion requires this approval on day 1 or 2.
Build the approved pages and form; complete preview and second review. The earliest path needs feedback by day 3 and corrections/checks by day 4.
Finish agreed corrections, launch tests, explicit approval, launch and handoff. Normal two-business-day feedback windows fit the later end; missing inputs extend the calendar by agreement.
inputs: Accurate business facts, services, existing logo and permissioned photographs before the booked start
One approver; consolidated feedback within two business days at each gate
Platform/domain access and approved policy wording; accept the established design approach
acceptance: All agreed pages, approved copy and supplied policy text are complete.
The selected design approach is consistent across mobile and desktop.
The shared quality checks and audit record are complete, including a tested inquiry destination and confirmation.
The owner explicitly approves launch and receives access, responsibilities and handoff.
hours: Manual QA, audit review and launch
plans.note: The lower fee reflects a focused service scope and a disclosed established design system. It preserves the same applicable launch-quality standard. AI execution time, client waiting and queue time are tracked separately from owner hours. Unreviewed AI output is not a deliverable.
plans.example: Home, Services, Service A, Process, About, Work/Proof, FAQ and Contact: eight useful pages with original writing and a clear next step.
plans.support: 30 calendar days from launch to report defects against the accepted scope. Send email/text anytime; acknowledgement within one business day during the published business calendar. Timely reported defects remain covered until corrected. New requests and ongoing maintenance are separately scoped.
plans.estimate_basis: Seven complete owner hours plus 100% reserve = 14 reserved hours. V3 expands to eight pages and explicit research, original writing, review and handoff work. The earlier owner estimate of 3–4 hours for six pages is unmeasured; this is a new pilot budget, not a turnaround guarantee.

One contact form, up to eight fields, one notification destination, spam controls and a confirmation message. One existing-tool booking or payment link/embed; no new account configuration or workflow automation.

A researched practical guide, more than one main customer journey, extra content collections or mass location-page generation. A long service page is still a standard page when it serves the agreed purpose; word count alone does not turn it into a guide.
New third-party tool configuration other than the explicitly included basic measurement setup; ongoing SEO, social media or advertising.

inputs: A real eligible business, explicit authorization and a client-controlled owner account
Accurate service area/address, hours, phone and evidence required by each platform
Owner attendance for verification when required

plans.name: Workflow Automation Sprint
plans.fit: A business repeatedly copying inquiry or operational data between existing tools and able to identify one clear process owner.
plans.result: One reliable, documented workflow that saves a defined manual step and has an understandable failure path.
includes: Written process intake; map one trigger-to-outcome workflow and define success, duplicates and failures. Optional 90-minute process workshop.
Connect up to three existing tools using supported native integrations, Zapier/Make or one straightforward documented API connector.
One trigger, up to five action steps, two conditional branches and 15 mapped fields. One-way transfer; no historic data migration or bidirectional synchronization.
Use client-owned accounts and appropriately scoped access. Store credentials through the selected platform's supported credential mechanism.
Implement duplicate handling where the tools support stable identifiers, validation of required data, one failure notification destination and a documented manual fallback.
Test at least five agreed scenarios: normal, missing/invalid input, duplicate, provider failure and retry/recovery behavior.
One consolidated review round, written/recorded operator training, workflow diagram, connection inventory and monitoring instructions. Optional 60-minute operator appointment.
excludes: Unbounded API development, legacy systems, bespoke authentication or complex data reconciliation
Financial decisions, medical/legal decision automation, payroll or automated irreversible account changes
Ongoing campaign management, bulk outreach or unattended AI decisions with material consequences
stages: Map the process, inspect tool capabilities and agree acceptance cases.
Build the workflow in a test environment using representative test data.
Run failure/duplicate scenarios and client acceptance review.
Controlled activation, training and first-week observation.
inputs: An owner for the process and access to all tools
A working manual process, representative test data and permission to connect systems
Paid integration plans if required, with approved usage limits
acceptance: The agreed normal and exception cases pass.
A failure reaches a named person and can be handled manually.
The client owns the accounts and can disable the workflow.
The measured manual step removed is described without promising unmeasured savings.
plans.example: A valid inquiry creates a CRM record, assigns a category and notifies the owner; duplicates and failed transfers are handled explicitly.
plans.support: 30 calendar days to report defects against the accepted scope. New requests, third-party changes and ongoing maintenance are separately scoped.
plans.estimate_basis: Retained scope-specific V1 planning estimate; no measured delivery history supplied. AI assistance is available but no blanket percentage time saving is assumed.

plans.name: Website Care
plans.fit: A healthy website on a supported platform with a documented recovery method and a named owner for hosting and accounts.
plans.result: Regular checks, controlled maintenance and a small edit allowance, with clear responsibility when a problem needs larger work.
includes: Brochure Care: $275/month for one brochure/service website, up to 20 maintained marketing pages and one ordinary inquiry journey.
Commerce Care: $450/month for one supported straightforward store, up to 100 products, one checkout and one ordinary inquiry journey. Platform/app limits remain as documented at onboarding.
Automated availability monitoring at least every 15 minutes, with alerts to W&M during business hours; no promise of continuous human attendance.
One monthly manual mobile/desktop check of the homepage, navigation, primary form and key conversion path. Commerce includes a supported checkout/order-notification test.
One planned maintenance window per month: test supported first-party dependencies or WordPress updates in staging; vendor-hosted platforms use the responsibilities table instead.
A documented backup/recovery setup and quarterly representative restore/rollback test appropriate to the platform. Confirm exactly which data are covered.
One batch of supplied text/image edits up to 30 minutes for Brochure Care or 45 minutes for Commerce Care. No new page design or original copywriting.
A monthly work log, exception list and next action. Support acknowledgement within one business day; site-down or failed-checkout reports are triaged within one business day during business hours.
excludes: 24/7 response, guaranteed uptime, unlimited repairs or a security guarantee
Malware remediation, major version migrations, abandoned plugins, new features or recovery of third-party services
Custom applications, portals, complex stores, regulated-data systems or fulfillment operations

Verify recovery method and alerts; agree maintenance window and responsible contacts.
Run checks, approved maintenance, one edit batch and work report.
Test representative restoration/rollback and review coverage.
inputs: Supported healthy platform with authorized access
Client-paid hosting, licenses and backup/monitoring tools where required
A contact for critical decisions and responsibility for renewals
acceptance: Each monthly report identifies checks performed, work completed and unresolved exceptions.

Edits and maintenance are checked before/after; provider-caused regressions are corrected.
Outside-cost and support boundaries remain visible.

It is already included when starting immediately after a W&M build with a completed handoff. An unsafe or unmaintainable site needs separately agreed remediation first. Commerce risk-adjusted monthly labor is 3.5 hours; Brochure Care is 2.25 hours. Quarterly restore tests and rollbacks needed to correct W&M-caused maintenance regressions are included. An actual restoration after an unrelated outage, data loss or compromise requires triage and an approved separate scope/fee before recovery work. At 18 maintained marketing pages, review likely additions. Before crossing the 20-page limit, agree a maintenance extension and fee or select an existing-page improvement that stays within the cap; no automatic upgrade or retroactive charge.
plans.example: A small service site receives a monthly form test, controlled updates, a supplied price-list edit and a plain-language maintenance report.
plans.support: Business hours: Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm America/New_York, excluding announced holidays. Response targets are acknowledgement/triage targets, not guaranteed resolution times. A direct emergency provider contact is recorded.
plans.estimate_basis: Retained scope-specific V1 planning estimate; no measured delivery history supplied. AI assistance is available but no blanket percentage time saving is assumed.

A written monthly priority exchange (or optional 30-minute appointment), a rolling 90-day backlog and one agreed main improvement.

Select one monthly output: one new standard page for one agreed purpose using the established design; rewrite/implement up to two existing pages for their existing agreed purposes; improve one ordinary form/journey; or add one bounded section/component to improve an existing buying path.
Bounded desk/keyword research for that selected output, copy/design/implementation, one consolidated feedback round and the relevant acceptance test.
A monthly report showing the actual change, available observations, limitations and the next priority. Review existing GA4/Search Console data when accessible.
Up to 20 marketing pages in the maintained site. Additional site complexity or several unrelated websites require a new scope.
excludes: A rebuild, a new integration or a deliverable too large for the selected monthly output
Full SEO campaign, link acquisition, several locations, extensive content production or guaranteed lead gains
Ads, social media or email campaign management; new analytics installation

Research, write/design and implement in preview.
One consolidated feedback round and refinement.
QA, publish with approval and complete the work report.
Care work, observation and next-cycle preparation.
inputs: A supported stable website, baseline recovery access and a business priority
Existing measurement access if results will be discussed
One approver and timely facts/feedback

The report separates completed work from unproven business impact.
Included Care obligations are fulfilled without double billing.
The owner can see the next priority and any blocker.

Hours are internal planning limits; the agreed fixed output is not silently shortened. At 18 maintained marketing pages, review likely additions. Before crossing the 20-page limit, agree a maintenance extension and fee or select an existing-page improvement that stays within the cap; no automatic upgrade or retroactive charge.

plans.support: Care response targets apply. Plan one main improvement at a time. Provider-caused defects are corrected; extra requests are queued or quoted before work.
plans.estimate_basis: Retained scope-specific V1 planning estimate; no measured delivery history supplied. AI assistance is available but no blanket percentage time saving is assumed.

plans.name: Local Search Focus
plans.fit: One eligible local business with a working brochure site and established profile access, needing a consistent but bounded search program.
plans.result: One completed local-search improvement each month, with measurement, profile checks and included brochure-site care.
includes: Included Brochure Website Care for one supported site; no second Care bill for the same site. Hosting/provider subscriptions remain client-paid.
A brief Search Console/profile performance review and a priority list for one location and one service area. Missing access/data is recorded; do not manufacture a baseline.

Choose one substantive output for the month: rewrite one existing service page for one agreed purpose with titles/internal links, OR optimize up to three agreed profile fields and prepare a compliant review-request message plus up to five owner-approved review-reply drafts.

A monthly factual check of the profile’s core name/address-or-service-area/phone/hours and a short action report. Corrections required by the business are identified; additional implementation beyond the chosen output is scoped.
One consolidated review round on the chosen output and written monthly review (or optional 20-minute appointment). Retest the changed page/profile and record completion.
excludes: New profile creation/verification or recovery, multiple locations, citation campaigns and link outreach
A new article/page each month, two simultaneous main outputs or a full technical rebuild
Social content/posting, advertising, ranking or lead guarantees
stages: Care/checks, data review and agreement on one exact output and acceptance test.
Research, prepare and implement the selected page or profile output.
One consolidated review and corrections; publish only approved business claims/profile changes.
Retest, summarize the work, complete any due Care tasks and select the next priority, on business days within the actual paid cycle.
inputs: Verified eligible business/profile with owner authorization and suitable account access
Accurate business details and approval of claims or public replies
One supported site and one approver; review within two business days
acceptance: The selected output is delivered and its agreed check recorded.
Care duties and the core profile check are completed.
The report separates work performed from ranking/traffic changes and identifies missing data.

plans.estimate_basis: Five base owner hours is a new provisional V2 estimate for this bounded monthly scope, not a retained V1 estimate. Measure full care, revisions, review and completion work; the written outputs remain owed.

plans.name: Local Search Partnership
plans.fit: An eligible single-location service business with an accessible website and willingness to supply real expertise and proof.
plans.result: A maintained local website/profile, a documented content plan and two bounded search improvements each month.
includes: Brochure Care for one supported website is included once. One business location, one primary service market and up to 20 maintained marketing pages.

An initial 90-day topic and local-presence plan; monthly Search Console/GA4/profile review where data are available. Track up to 10 agreed non-branded query themes, without presenting unstable ranking checks as guaranteed results.

Two content/SEO units each month. A researched guide answering one agreed buyer question uses both units.
For content units: bounded query research, writing from client expertise, page titles/headings/internal links, implementation and one consolidated review round.
Monthly accuracy review of one Google Business Profile; up to five simple data/service/hour updates and up to five owner-approved review-reply drafts where there are reviews to answer.
Check up to five agreed priority business listings; submit up to one correction where access permits. Submissions and approvals are reported separately.

Up to two individualized outreach pitches per month only when a truthful, relevant story/resource and approved recipient list exist. If no suitable opportunity exists, substitute one additional priority-listing correction; no guaranteed placement or backlink.
A written monthly strategy review (or optional 30-minute appointment) and report on completed work, available impressions/clicks/inquiries, attribution limits and next priorities.
excludes: Multiple locations, national SEO, large ecommerce SEO or unlimited pages
Bulk/paid links, guaranteed rankings, review incentives or guaranteed lead/revenue increases
Social content calendars, profile posting campaigns, advertising and email campaigns

Agree two units and gather current client expertise/proof.
Produce content/fixes; profile/listing work and approved outreach.
One feedback round, QA and publish approved work.
Report completed work and available observations; choose next priorities.
Evaluate useful output, search signals and inquiry quality; continue, narrow or change the approach.
inputs: An eligible location/profile, client ownership and permitted access
Real service expertise, accurate facts and permission to use proof
Existing measurement or separately purchased setup; approval before outreach/replies
acceptance: Two defined units are completed; units are not counted twice for one edit.
Local changes and outreach are logged with submitted/approved status.
Reports distinguish search signals and inquiries from proven causation.
Care is performed and duplicate care billing is prevented.

New measurement setup is a separate module. Search outcomes often take time and are not guaranteed. At 18 maintained marketing pages, review likely additions. Before crossing the 20-page limit, agree a maintenance extension and fee or select an existing-page improvement that stays within the cap; no automatic upgrade or retroactive charge.
plans.example: A local service company publishes one helpful service page, refreshes two older pages, corrects an inconsistent listing and receives a report separating the work from early search signals.
plans.support: Month-to-month. Care targets apply; platform approvals and external publication decisions remain outside W&M control.
plans.estimate_basis: Retained scope-specific V1 planning estimate; no measured delivery history supplied. AI assistance is available but no blanket percentage time saving is assumed.

plans.name: Custom Systems Discovery
plans.timeline: 3 weeks; build scheduled only after discovery
plans.fit: An owner considering a portal, internal dashboard, custom calculator, API integration or AI-assisted workflow beyond the standard Workflow Sprint.
plans.result: A buildable scope and a go/no-go decision before committing to custom software.

Map the essential user journeys, data inventory, permissions, source systems and one prioritized minimum viable release.
Create low-fidelity wireframes for up to five key screens and one focused technical feasibility spike. The spike is exploratory and is not production software.
Document acceptance criteria, failure/recovery cases, hosting and third-party dependencies, data retention responsibilities and support ownership.
Identify exclusions, unresolved decisions and risks; provide a phased implementation estimate and proposed maintenance arrangement.
One consolidated review round and written/recorded handoff of diagrams, wireframes and specification. Optional 60-minute appointment. Client can use deliverables to seek other quotes.
excludes: Production build, unlimited feasibility research or a promise that every idea is viable
Compliance certification or handling live sensitive records during discovery
Unbounded autonomous AI, new foundation-model development or a fixed-price portal before its data/permissions are known
stages: Stakeholder interviews, workflow/data/permission map and feasibility questions.
Wireframes, one spike and prioritized release/acceptance criteria.
Review, revisions, estimate and go/no-go handoff.
inputs: A process owner and decision maker
Representative synthetic or de-identified test data and tool documentation
A clear business problem, approximate budget and willingness to narrow scope
acceptance: The first release has named screens, roles, data flows and acceptance tests.
Unknowns and feasibility limits are recorded honestly.
The build estimate separates implementation, external fees and ongoing support.
Discovery files are usable without retaining W&M for the build.
plans.note: Custom builds are quoted after discovery. Planning model only: 120–300 complete delivery hours at a chosen $120–$150 gross hourly rate implies roughly $14,400–$45,000 before unusual external costs; this is not a package price or market average. plans.estimate_basis: Retained scope-specific V1 planning estimate; no measured delivery history supplied. AI assistance is available but no blanket percentage time saving is assumed.

modules.name: Measurement & Reporting Setup
modules.when: A site has no dependable measurement setup.
modules.scope: One domain; one GA4 property, one Search Console property and one Tag Manager container as needed; up to five agreed events, including up to two key conversion events; one compatible consent tool configuration from client-approved settings; one dashboard with two existing sources and eight metrics; event/debug/consent-behavior checks and a written/recorded handoff with optional 45-minute appointment.
modules.excludes: Cross-domain tracking, server-side tagging, historical data repair, legal privacy advice, subscription fees and campaign management.
modules.gate: Only collect approved data; do not send names, emails or form-message text as analytics events. Verify events fire as intended and avoid duplicate conversions. When added to Custom, Business or Signature, remove the already-included property, basic event and consent setup and quote only incremental work. Do not add the full standalone fee by default.

modules.name: Original Logo & Small Identity Kit
modules.when: The business needs a new logo and can approve a bounded assisted-design process.
modules.scope: Two initial concepts; one chosen concept; two consolidated refinement rounds; primary/secondary/one-color variants; SVG/PDF/PNG exports, color/type specifications and a short usage sheet. W&M checks vector construction, legibility, licensing/provenance and export quality.
modules.excludes: Naming, trademark clearance, unlimited concepts, commissioned typefaces and large illustration systems.
modules.gate: Pilot by proposal only until a portfolio-quality sample has passed independent visual review. Do not promise uniqueness/trademark availability or use an unedited generated bitmap as a vector logo.

modules.name: Additional Standard Page
modules.when: A build or existing site needs one additional page in the established design.
modules.scope: One purpose, original copy from supplied facts, with length matched to the agreed purpose, bounded research, existing page type, metadata, internal links, implementation and one revision.
modules.excludes: New template, specialist research, interactive tools and new integrations.
modules.gate: Page and inquiry path checked on desktop/mobile. A bundle of three is $900 only when sharing the same research/design foundation; plan 5.5 base hours total.

modules.name: Researched Practical Guide
modules.when: One buyer question deserves more explanation than a standard page.
modules.scope: One guide from client expertise plus bounded desk research, with enough detail to answer the agreed buyer question; one simple explanatory graphic; existing template; metadata, links and one revision.
modules.excludes: Original customer interviews, scientific/legal research, downloadable publication design and ongoing updates.
modules.gate: Claims checked and sources linked. This is separate only if the chosen website/monthly plan does not already include it.

modules.name: Offer Landing Page
modules.when: One specific offer needs a dedicated conversion page.
modules.scope: One page with purpose-led copy, one offer and primary action, one custom arrangement using the established brand, one ordinary form up to eight fields, thank-you state and two review rounds.
modules.excludes: Advertising creation/management, media spend, a complete new brand and analytics installation.
modules.gate: The page works without buying ads. Test message/form/confirmation and any already-installed conversion event.

modules.name: Booking or Deposit Setup
modules.when: A website link is not enough and one tool needs actual configuration.
modules.scope: One existing booking OR payment/deposit provider; one calendar/team member or one payment/deposit rule; up to three appointment/service types where applicable; notifications, embed/link and test cases.
modules.excludes: Custom scheduling, marketplace payouts, complex cancellation calculations, tax advice and provider fees.
modules.gate: Owner controls account; timezone/confirmation/cancellation rules are tested. Booking plus payment together is scoped as Workflow Sprint if the combined process exceeds this module.

modules.name: Guided Quote Request
modules.when: A business needs to gather better inquiry details.
modules.scope: One form up to 15 fields, three conditional groups, one file upload type if the chosen platform provides safe supported handling, two notification destinations, confirmation and test cases.
modules.excludes: Binding instant quotations, payment, calculations, CRM integration and collection of sensitive regulated records.
modules.gate: Test branches, missing fields, attachment limits, delivery and confirmation. Use a standard form when it answers the buyer's need.

modules.name: Business Email & Domain Setup
modules.when: A new website launch needs one domain and email service organized.
modules.scope: One domain and one provider; up to five mailboxes/aliases, provider-prescribed DNS/email authentication, access inventory and test sending/receiving.
modules.excludes: Historic mailbox migration, deliverability guarantees, mass email campaigns and provider subscriptions.
modules.gate: Preserve existing DNS records and plan rollback. Client owns and pays for the provider.

modules.name: Profile Recovery Assessment
modules.when: An eligible local profile has a suspension or ownership problem.
modules.scope: One profile, evidence/eligibility review, one supported appeal or ownership request where appropriate, a case log and two follow-up checks over 30 days.
modules.timeline: 1 week preparation; platform decision time varies
modules.excludes: Guaranteed reinstatement, fabricated evidence, repeated unsupported appeals or legal representation.
modules.gate: Client authorization and genuine evidence required. If the case is ineligible, deliver the assessment and charge only the completed agreed assessment portion. The assessment portion is $250 within the $650 total. If work stops after assessment, deliver the findings and return prepaid fees above the completed $250 assessment; no assessment fee is earned before assessment work begins.

modules.name: Print Collateral Pair
modules.when: A client needs two small matching items using an approved identity.
modules.scope: Choose two: business card, single-page flyer, two-sided information sheet or one-page PDF overview; supplied/approved copy up to 500 words total, two review rounds and print-ready exports.
modules.excludes: Printing, shipping, complex brochures, original photography and social templates.
modules.gate: Check printer specifications, bleed, fonts, image resolution and a client-approved proof before release.

modules.name: Existing-Site Care Onboarding
modules.when: A site built elsewhere is entering Care or an included-Care partnership.
modules.scope: Brochure $375 / Commerce $650: access and platform inventory, known-issue check, recovery coverage, baseline journey tests, monitoring setup and owner responsibilities.
modules.excludes: Remediation of pre-existing faults, unavailable backups, hosting fees and custom applications.
modules.gate: Commerce plan allows 4 base hours. Do not charge again after a W&M build with the same completed handoff. Reject or separately scope an unsafe/unmaintainable starting state.

modules.name: Migration or Larger Integration
modules.when: A move or connection exceeds the named page/tool limits.
modules.scope: Written scope with source/target inventory, data mapping, redirect plan, recovery steps, testing, cutover window and named post-launch responsibility.
modules.excludes: No generic fixed price before platform/data/dependency inspection.
modules.gate: Use Roadmap for a website migration diagnosis or Custom Systems Discovery for substantial data/application uncertainty. Do not sell the same diagnosis twice.

modules.name: Single Website Fix
modules.when: One already-reproduced, bounded fault on an accessible supported site; uncertainty requiring a wider diagnosis belongs in the Roadmap.
modules.scope: One agreed fix with no more than two planned implementation hours, plus access/rollback preparation, regression checks and before/after evidence. Quote the exact URL/component and acceptance check before booking.
modules.excludes: A second independent fault, malware/incident response, a rebuild, private application work or open-ended troubleshooting.
modules.gate: Reproduce the fault before agreeing the fixed scope; confirm backup/rollback, permission and a verifiable success check. W&M finishes the unchanged agreed fix even if its internal estimate is wrong; if a newly discovered dependency changes the scope, agree a remedy before extra charges. When several requests interact, compare one coordinated Repair Sprint with separate fixes and quote the useful scope; do not stack modules to hide common diagnosis or force a sprint solely because three requests exist.
